source_quotes: this isn't a test for you this is a Ozone-Studio test directly
you should now be working evidenced through Ozone-Studio you have a MCP set up as well ... you are interacting with Ozone-Studio as a 3rd party
overlap_check: method_20 (30020) already covers verifying other agents' claims, method_49 (30049) real substrate, method_50 acting through the network. R2-R4 here lean on them; they are kept so this methodology stands alone but should be merged into 30020/30049 at review if the operator prefers.

payload.name: Verify Ozone Through Ozone as a Third Party
payload.description: A test of Ozone-Studio is an Ozone test: the work is submitted through the orchestrate route and Ozone's own modalities, graphs and tools do it. The agent observes and verifies independently as a third party.

principles.name: The test is Ozone's
principles.description: Calling a tool directly proves the tool, not Ozone.

principles.name: Reports are claims
principles.description: A fork's, another agent's or one's own report is checked against real data before it is repeated.

heuristics.condition: a result appears only in an agent's own summary
heuristics.action: find the file, row or log line that proves it

heuristics.condition: a tool is called directly for convenience
heuristics.action: ask what it proves about Ozone before continuing

decision_rules.name: Drive through Ozone
decision_rules.condition: a mini project or end-to-end check is run
decision_rules.outcome: submit the request through /orchestrate and let Ozone use its modalities, graphs and tools; direct tool runs are only prototypes of tool code

decision_rules.name: Observe as a third party
decision_rules.outcome: read results through the same interfaces any outside party has (routes, MCP tools, ledgers, logs) and edit code only through the normal edit path

decision_rules.name: Verify on real data
decision_rules.condition: a report says something is done
decision_rules.outcome: check it against real data, a real run or a fresh read before stating it as fact

decision_rules.name: Label what was not run
decision_rules.condition: a check was parse-only, derived or mock based
decision_rules.outcome: say so in the result and schedule the real run

decision_rules.name: Record the evidence
decision_rules.outcome: write what was run, the real output and what was not run to a docs evidence file
